references.text: God speaks to Moses from a cloud on Mount Sinai, which mirrors how God speaks from a cloud in Matthew 17:5.
Moses tells of a prophet whom God will raise up, and the people must listen to him, similar to the call to listen to Jesus in Matthew 17:5.
A psalm that refers to the king as God's son, which can be seen in connection with God's confirmation of Jesus as His Son in Matthew 17:5.
God confirms Jesus as His beloved Son at his baptism, parallel to the confirmation in Matthew 17:5.
God speaks from heaven about Jesus, similar to the voice from the cloud in Matthew 17:5.
Peter's letter refers to the event on the Mount of Transfiguration, directly related to Matthew 17:5.
